source.title: Larne Times, 5 January 1924, p. 2 ("Larne Urban Council. Election Nominations.")
source.publisher: Larne Times (via the British Newspaper Archive)
source.check: Each ward had a single nomination, so all five were returned unopposed; the paper states that no poll would be necessary.

note: Annual election of five urban councillors, one for each ward, January 1924; no poll was necessary (Larne Times, 5 January 1924, p. 2). Mr. Patton was a new member, replacing Mr. James Pattison. Returned unopposed.
